title: Justin
creator: CrossFit
description: 30-20-10 reps of bodyweight back squats, bodyweight bench presses and strict pull-ups. Honours U.S. Marine Sgt. Justin M. Hansen, 2nd Marine Special Operations Battalion, killed in Badghis Province, Afghanistan, in 2012. Set targets to your bodyweight; scale to 75% if 30 unbroken is out of reach.
